# add_maxima_to_rag { #mofography.compute.add_maxima_to_rag }

```python
compute.add_maxima_to_rag(G, maxima, maxima_radii, shape, ase_atoms)
```

Attach watershed maxima indices, coordinates, and radii to each RAG node.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type   | Description                                                         | Default    |
|--------------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| G            |        | the graph                                                           | _required_ |
| maxima       |        | the indices of the maxima (2nd output of regions_from_grid routine) | _required_ |
| maxima_radii |        | the radius of the maxima                                            | _required_ |
| shape        |        | the shape of the image                                              | _required_ |
| ase_atoms    |        | The atoms object from ASE                                           | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                  |
|--------|--------|----------------------------------------------|
|        |        | The graph with the maxima added to the nodes |
